$comment: Source scope of package fr/pf-aeeh (wave 3 + finish wave, CNAF-PFAEEH): 21 CSS articles, registry cut 2026-10-06. Bytes: alineas of the registry (.scratch/reg-css.json, DILA LEGI mirror) for current versions; 3 in-window superseded R versions from the mirror dump (reform pairs). The OpenFisca 2012-01 cases run on the same pinned D. 541-1/2 rates (in force since 2006-01-01). BMAF euro figures and the MTP amount (L. 341-4, external) are NOT pinned (owner input D-Q4 / DSS_PENDING). The R. 541-1..10 mechanics (thresholds, category criteria, durations, silence, death extension) are pinned since the finish wave; the category expense amounts, the evaluation guide and the arretes-set declaration/urgency values stay retained case inputs. DOM transfer (D-73): L755-20 (VIGUEUR since 2015-10-16) and D755-11 (VIGUEUR since 2006-01-01) cover the whole program window, no predecessors.

declared_gaps.R541-2-expense-arretes: each 'montant fixe par arrete' of R. 541-2 is unpinned: retained seuil_depenses_retenu inputs (B-PFAEEH-SEUILS-ARRETE)
declared_gaps.R541-2-guide: the R. 541-2 evaluation guide (arrete-defined) is unpinned: only the article's stated criteria are executable (B-PFAEEH-GUIDE-EVALUATION)
declared_gaps.R541-3-modele: the R. 541-3 declaration model (joint arretes) is unpinned: declaration contents arrive as case facts (B-PFAEEH-MODELE-ARRETE)
declared_gaps.R541-4-urgence: the R. 541-4 IV urgent-decision deadline (joint arrete) is unpinned: the duty to decide urgently has no computable date (B-PFAEEH-DELAI-URGENCE)

pinned_old_versions.R541-1-2005: LEGIARTI000006750709, 2005-12-20..2022-01-31 (last alinea without the decree 2022-85 death extension)
